description: This file is a test suite for the gateway startup channel maintenance functionality, using the Vitest testing framework. It sets up mocks, initializes the server with a specific configuration, and verifies that the startup maintenance function is called correctly during the test.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, including configuration and starting the server.

methods.name: afterAll
methods.description: Cleans up after tests by closing the server.

methods.name: installGatewayTestHooks
methods.description: Initializes test hooks for the gateway tests.

methods.name: startGatewayServer
methods.description: Starts the gateway server on a free port.

methods.name: getFreePort
methods.description: Retrieves an available network port for testing.
